Q6113.reason: Common-law arson requires malice; inadvertently forgetting the stove is mere negligence, not an intentional or reckless burning.

Q9000.reason: GA resolutions are not binding formal sources or treaties and do not always state custom; they are material sources that may enunciate customary law.

Q9002.reason: “Provided that if … may re-enter” is conditional language plus a right of entry in the grantor, creating a fee simple subject to condition subsequent.
